author: Yffe
content: Fixed in eae38c3 (thermite-spec/src/validator.rs). Root cause: validator cage-checked ordinary fn-BODY statement expressions (walk_block->walk_stmt->walk_expr), rejecting 'return Some(mid);' as UnknownCombinator. Fix: separated STRUCTURAL traversal from CAGE-CHECKING — new scan_block_for_loops/scan_stmt_for_loops/scan_expr_for_loops descend a fn body ONLY to find nested LoopNodes and cage each loop's invs/dec; the body's other expressions are NOT cage-checked. run() now calls scan_block_for_loops(&f.body) for fn items; spec fn bodies keep the caged walk_block (REQ-3). Authority: .design/spec/spectherm-combinators.md REQ-3 + AC-2. Verify: the two #35 tests now PASS (un-ignored); both corpus programs validate Ok; cargo test -p thermite-spec 8 passed 0 failed 0 ignored; clippy/fmt/workspace-build PASS; inv/dec/spec-fn-body bogus-combinator rejection still works.
